description: Defines the NinjaTargetWriter class responsible for generating Ninja build files for a specific target, including methods for writing build rules, handling dependencies, and managing output files.

classes.name: NinjaTargetWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for generating Ninja build files for a specific target, managing build rules, dependencies, and output files.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Pure virtual method to execute the writing process for the target.

methods.name: GetResolvedTargetData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the ResolvedTargetData instance used internally.

methods.name: WriteSharedVars
methods.description: Writes shared substitution variables between different tools.

methods.name: WriteCCompilerVars
methods.description: Writes substitution variables for C compiler tools and actions.

methods.name: WriteRustCompilerVars
methods.description: Writes substitution variables for Rust tools and actions.

methods.name: WriteInputDepsStampOrPhonyAndGetDep
methods.description: Writes dependencies as a stamp or phony rule and returns dependency files.

methods.name: WriteStampOrPhonyForTarget
methods.description: Writes a final phony rule for target dependencies.

methods.name: WriteOutput
methods.description: Writes a Ninja output file to the stream.
